compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 assigns GND (GND) whereas AP7313-33SAG-7 assigns IN (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VOUT pin (VOUT vs OUT).
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 assigns VIN (VIN) whereas AP7313-33SAG-7 assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Soldering AP7313-33SAG-7 onto a AP2210N-3.3TRG1 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AP7313-33SAG-7 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 1 µF, p.10), whereas AP2210N-3.3TRG1 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.025–15 Ω (p.22)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AP2210N-3.3TRG1 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7313-33SAG-7 is rated to only 6 V rec. (7 V abs max, p.4) vs AP2210N-3.3TRG1 at 13.2 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP7313-33SAG-7 supplies up to 150 mA (p.4) compared to AP2210N-3.3TRG1 at 300 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP7313-33SAG-7 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (7 V, p.4) than AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (15 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 7 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 2.5 V (p.4) vs 2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) and AP7313-33SAG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 51 °C on AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (θJA 200 °C/W) vs 52.8 °C on AP7313-33SAG-7 (θJA 207 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.8x ratio (100 µA (p.11) vs 55 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 "SOT-23-3 Pinout (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) Reversed vs AP7333-SA, AP7313-SA, and LM3480" (p.1) and AP7313-33SAG-7 "Single-Letter Ordering Trap: SA vs SR/AP2210N Reverses Pins 1 & 3 (and LM3480 Differs Too)" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose AP2210N-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 150 mA (up to 300 mA) or input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 13.2 V); choose AP7313-33SAG-7 when battery sleep budget demands 55 µA Iq or your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
